name: Albright Innovations
summary: Albright Innovations helps small and medium businesses get more customers and run more smoothly. We manage social media, Facebook and Instagram ads, Google Business Profiles and websites. We set up a 24/7 assistant that answers website and phone enquiries and sends the lead to the owner, and we improve the systems behind the scenes: customer lists, phones, scheduling, quoting, invoicing, follow-up and lead tracking. Based in Big Rapids, Michigan and the Charlotte, North Carolina area, working with businesses anywhere in the U.S.

services.name: Operations check
services.desc: A walk-through of how work moves through your business, from the first call to the final invoice, and where time and leads slip away.

services.name: A 24/7 assistant for your website and phone
services.desc: Answers common questions on your website or phone line, takes the customer's details and sends them to you right away, day or night.

services.name: The right tools for how you work
services.desc: Customer list, scheduling, phones, quoting, invoicing and job tracking, chosen to fit how you work and the tools you already have.

services.name: Workflows and follow-up
services.desc: Clear steps from first call to close to follow-up, so nothing depends on someone remembering.

services.name: Lead tracking and reporting
services.desc: Working out where your customers come from, so you know which ads, posts and referrals bring in paying work.

services.name: Social media management
services.desc: Posts planned, scheduled and answered, so your page stays active without you living on it.

services.name: Google Business Profile and reviews
services.desc: Your Google listing kept current, with posts and a steady way of asking for reviews.

services.name: Social ads
services.desc: Facebook and Instagram ads aimed at people near you who are ready to buy.

services.name: Websites
services.desc: A clean, current site that tells people who you are, what you do and how to reach you.

tools.name: Where does your week go?
tools.desc: Add up the hours you spend on quotes, scheduling, invoicing, retyping and social media, and see what they cost per year.

tools.name: Missed-call calculator
tools.desc: Estimate the jobs and revenue at risk from unanswered calls and slow follow-up.
